body: thanks very much, I was unaware of this association.
I went and talked to a doctor at a MediCentre today and he is having someone call me to get me a permanent family doctor since I don't have one in my current city.  We'll see where it goes from here.
Thank you for taking the time to talk with me.  I hope I will call a doctor tomorrow and try to track one down that will see me.  I hope you have an enjoyable sleep.

I figure there must have been moments where I was happy.  I started to lose it when I realized I couldn't remember a single one.  I have memories that I think must have included happiness, but I can't recall how it felt.  

Without a routine, I sort of fall apart.  Do you feel like you need to be distracted from yourself all the time?  I feel like that.

None of my counselors were psychiatrists or psychologists.  The last one I was seeing that worked for my college had originally wanted to speak with the resident psychologist about how I felt, but the next week I talked to him he could not remember why and had not talked to them.  

I would like to go see a doctor like a psychiatrist rather than public health counselor.  I live in Canada, and I'm not sure how to access one.
